verdict.rationale: Poly documents that new journal entries are stored as Markdown files in the Mind folder. User files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer, can be pinned so they stay fully downloaded, and can be copied from Poly to local disk with the `poly cp` command, so the notes archive lives as ordinary open files that can be taken out. missing for 10: a documented format for Mind memories (e.g. JSON or Markdown), an explicit bulk-export feature, any mention of JSON export, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the export path.
